formulas.CI95: 99999 fixed UTC-week block percentile bootstrap draws, 2.5/97.5 percentiles; insufficient if fewer than 100 trades or eight weeks
formulas.WF_gate: three TESTED expanding development folds, each net_profit>0 and PF>=1.10; selection-dependent development stability only
formulas.financial_gates: n>=100, PF>=1.10, DD<=0.20, net_profit>0, net_return>costed B&H and native reference
formulas.p: (1+count(centered week bootstrap null >= observed mean net_R))/100000
formulas.statistical_gate: mean_net_R CI95 lower>0 AND PF CI95 lower>1
formulas.validation_score: net_return/max(max_drawdown,0.005)*sqrt(n/(n+100)); -1e12 if n<10 or net_return<=0 or unknown paths

historical_exposure_limitation.frozen_declaration_history_exposure: Adaptive history; previously exposed intervals remain disclosed
historical_exposure_limitation.scope: Final data was sealed from tuning within this campaign, but historical intervals had been exposed in earlier research; adaptive, retrospective evidence, not fresh prospective independent OOS.

limitations: Root replay uses original frozen production formulas, not an independent mathematical implementation.
Only selected 1300 final originals and 3900 selected development folds were numerically replayed; 38400 development-search measurements were not all numerically rerun.
Receipt and ledger match totals overlap policies and are not independent market-event samples.
Historical CFD costs, cash mapping, financing, fills and full original-tick strategy execution remain unverified.
Previously exposed history is not fresh prospective OOS; development folds depend on policy selection.
All 13 families were predeclared; 32 parameter rounds do not prove one newly invented family per cycle.
The original raw search CSV is unchanged; metrics are validation and selected dispositions are final. The added partition labels clarify this mix.

limits: All final policies remain rejected; financial-only survivors are an exhaustive descriptive audit, not a final-based selection or promotion.
13 fixed families and 32 parameter rounds; no proof of inventing a new family every cycle.
Completed fresh replay is 1,300 selected final + 3,900 selected development folds; it does not replay 38,400 development-search measurements.
Replay uses original frozen production formulas, not an independent mathematical implementation.
0.10 ATR round-trip costs and CFD/account mapping are assumptions; execution NOT_VERIFIED.
Historical intervals were previously exposed/adaptive; the campaign-sealed final is not prospective independent evidence.
A requested year is not proof of the provider's maximum history.
All histories retain source defects; no gap-free replacement or interpolation was introduced.
Trade counts across different policies overlap and cannot be summed as independent events.

This single-frame 60/20/20 campaign is distinct from the earlier multi-frame 70/30 spike-definition experiment; it does not substitute win rate or holding time for precision/recall/lift/time-to-spike.
CI/GitHub publication status is excluded here; it must be verified separately on the actual published head.
